ops.body: - [loop] From the UI review (Nov 20, low, U4): at 320 px "Camera" fills its button edge to edge; at 200% text it would be cut. The row needs a picture at 200% text and buttons that grow taller, wrapping only between words.

- [loop] From the UI review (Nov 20, low, U5): the place card's Close is an unlabelled X in the bottom row beside Route here (T5, matrix 23 put Close top right). It predates this slice; every walk card shares it.

- [loop] From the UI review (Nov 20, low, U6): a note has two glyphs, the document (the stack, the card's row) and the pencil in a square (the Add to this moment pill, note pins). It predates this slice.

- [loop] From the UI review (Nov 20, low, U9, opinion): the card can cover the place it describes (the pin and its label under the card at 320). Panning the map so the pin sits above the card would keep the two together.
- [loop] From the cold find (Nov 20, low): "Camera" says nothing of video; its spoken name does ("a photo or video"), as the stack's does.

ops.intro: What the capture-at-a-place slice left for the owner (`specs/capture-at-a-place/spec.md`, decision 0240).

ops.body: - **A memo begun on a place's card** (the UI review's U7, low): once the card closes, the recording shows only its timer, so nothing says the memo will be kept with the place. A status, not the armed line you ruled out: "Hessian Memorial · 0:01" in the timer pill. Add it, or leave the timer alone?

- **The found pin's look** (the UI review's U2, medium; its hit area is fixed, 44 px, under the moment pins): it stays small (26 by 32) and nameless, as an earlier audit made it, though it is now the only way to a found place's card. Keep it small, or draw it the size of an unfound pin with its name?
